name: 喜院湘菜馆 Diner's Garden
reviews: 喜院的香辣蟹真的超出预期！！是听室友说他们香辣蟹做活动 想说过去尝尝 蟹肉饱满新鲜，土豆等配菜粘汤超级好吃！美女姐姐赠送了一道菜。性价比直接拉满，爱吃蟹的一定要来试试！臭豆腐火锅也非常下饭，朋友说非常夯！

Late night meal. Experienced friendly staff. Great value for money. 1st anniversary specials if you spend $58. Hot pot was so nice and comforting on a cold night. Will definitely be back for more Hunan food.

Great food, friendly service, and a welcoming atmosphere. The dishes were fresh, flavorful, and well prepared. Overall, it was a very enjoyable dining experience. I would definitely come back and recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious Hunan cuisine.

My favourite Chinese restaurant， the ingredients are very fresh and the flavors are rich and authentic. If you love spicy food, this place is definitely worth trying — the dishes have a great balance of heat and fragrance. The outdoor seating area is also very pleasant, making it a great spot to enjoy a meal. Highly recommended.
2. 口味完全超出预期，上菜速度快，环境安静舒服，价格实惠，不管一人简餐还是朋友小聚都合适，五星推荐！
